e.title: InsurMinds 挑战五：五个智能体里只有写消息那个用大模型，「该通知谁」交给业务规则智能体
e.title_en: InsurMinds challenge five: only the message-writing agent uses an LLM, while "who to notify" is handled by a business-rules agent
e.title_hk: InsurMinds 挑戰五：五個智能體裡只有寫訊息那個用大模型，「該通知誰」交給業務規則智能體
e.summary: 一个葡萄牙语的气象预警触达原型：实时查询十个巴西城市（含沿海地区）的天气，识别强降雨、强风与冰雹风险风暴，按业务规则判定哪些险种与哪些投保人应被通知，再由大模型为每位受影响投保人生成个性化消息，并模拟发送；五个智能体里只有生成消息那个调用大模型，而「该通知谁」由独立且确定性的业务规则智能体决定
e.summary_hk: 一個葡萄牙語的氣象預警觸達原型：實時查詢十個巴西城市（含沿海地區）的天氣，識別強降雨、強風與冰雹風險風暴，按業務規則判定哪些險種與哪些投保人應被通知，再由大模型為每位受影響投保人生成個性化訊息，並模擬發送；五個智能體裡只有生成訊息那個調用大模型，而「該通知誰」由獨立且確定性的業務規則智能體決定
e.summary_en: A Portuguese-language weather-warning outreach prototype: it queries live conditions for ten Brazilian cities including coastal regions, identifies heavy rain, strong wind and hail-risk storms, applies business rules to decide which lines of insurance and which policyholders should be notified, then has an LLM generate a personalised message per affected policyholder and simulates the send; of its five agents only the message generator calls an LLM, while "who to notify" is decided by a separate deterministic business-rules agent
e.body:
**insurminds-desafio5** 是一个**葡萄牙语的气象预警触达原型**（仓库 `EDNARDOPPEIXOTO99/insurminds-desafio5-comunicacao-proativa`），**实测 MIT 许可（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 200）、★1、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 337 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**实测 topics 10 项**：**`agentes-inteligentes`、`google-gemini`、`i2a2`、`ia-generativa`、`insurtech`、`langchain`、`openweathermap`、`python`、**`seguros`**、`streamlit`**；**README 实测 4,518 字节（葡萄牙语）**。**已实测存在的关键文件**：**`src/rules_agent.py`、`data/segurados.csv`、`LICENSE`**。本条目属于本轮主题**「分开『我看到了什么』与『我因此断定什么』」**中的**第二种，也是本站首次收录**葡萄牙语**项目**（**此前多轮词条均以「是否有中文材料未核实」收尾；本条**语言即为葡萄牙语，**已如实记入**）。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**标题逐字为「InsurMinds — Desafio 5 / **Ferramenta Inteligente para Comunicação Proativa com o Segurado**」**（**「与投保人主动沟通的智能工具」**），**作者团队逐字为「**Grupo InsurTech Minds**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其定位逐字，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「Protótipo (MVP) que monitoriza condições meteorológicas em tempo real e gera comunicações automáticas e personalizadas para segurados, **antes que um sinistro ocorra** — **transformando o modelo reativo das seguradoras em uma abordagem preventiva**.」**——**即「一个监控实时气象条件、并在**理赔发生之前**为投保人生成自动且个性化沟通的原型（MVP）——**把保险公司的**被动反应模式**转变为**主动预防模式**」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「五个智能体里只有生成消息那个用大模型」是本条目最重要的一点，也是本轮主题最清晰的分工样本**——**其多智能体架构逐字实测**：**① `ColetorClimaticoAgent`**（**按城市查询 OpenWeatherMap API**）；**② `AnalisadorEventosAgent`**（**识别相关事件：降雨／风／风暴**）；**③ `RegrasNegocioAgent`**（**决定哪些投保人应被通知**）；**④ `GeradorMensagemAgent`**（**通过大模型 Gemini 生成个性化消息**）；**⑤ `SimuladorEnvioAgent`**（**记录模拟发送，无真实集成**）。⭐⭐⭐ **即：**感知与判定全部由确定性智能体完成，大模型只负责**把已定好的决定写成一句人话****——**这与本站连续多轮出现的同一条判断一致**（**第 329 轮 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 按列型切分、同轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 正则优先、第 330 轮 [[actuary-os]] 按架构切分、第 331 轮 [[claim-ops]] 写成偏好序＋禁止清单、第 332 轮 [[paco-uw]] 把规则做成纯数据、第 332 轮 [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] 把理算人路由留给规则引擎、本轮 [[claimlens]] 把成本与法律引用留给纯确定性规则**）；**本条的特点是**粒度最细**：**在同一个多智能体流程里，**恰好一个**智能体是生成式的****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「把保险公司的被动模式转成主动模式」是本条目在业务立意上最值得记的一点**——**它做的事是**在理赔发生之前**触达投保人****（**例如预报强降雨时提前通知住宅险投保人**）；⭐⭐ **对做保险创新的学生，这是一条**把保险从「事后赔付」向「事前减损」推移**的具体路径**——**而减损（loss mitigation）在精算上直接影响赔付频率**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该原型已量化任何减损效果**——**其输出为消息生成与模拟发送，README 未提及任何减损度量**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其业务规则表逐字实测，且是「事件 → 受影响险种」的显式映射**：**「Chuva intensa（强降雨）→ **Residencial（住宅险）**」；「Tempestade (risco de granizo)（风暴，含冰雹风险）→ **Automóvel e Residencial（车险与住宅险）**」；「Vento forte（强风）→ **Residencial」**。⭐⭐ **对做巨灾或天气险的学生，这张表把**气象事件类型**与**受影响的险种**直接连起来**——**即它是一个**简化但正确的「危险—暴露」映射****（**可与 [[catrisk-sim]]、[[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]]、[[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、[[open-meteo]]、[[gdacs]]、[[hurricaneguard]] 并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该映射完整或符合任何保险公司的实际条款**——**例如强风显然也可能影响车险，而表中只列住宅险**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **一条「这不是 bug」的预置说明，是本条目在文档质量上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「Como os dados climáticos são consultados **em tempo real**, os eventos disparados dependem do clima do dia em que você rodar a aplicação. **Se nenhuma das 10 cidades da base estiver com chuva/vento forte no momento, nenhuma notificação será gerada — isso é o comportamento correto do sistema, não um bug.** Para testar a geração de mensagens a qualquer momento, ajuste temporariamente os limiares no `.env` (`LIMIAR_CHUVA_MM`, `LIMIAR_VENTO_MS`) para valores bem baixos.」**——**即「由于气象数据是**实时**查询的，触发的事件取决于你运行当天天气。**若数据库中 10 个城市当前都没有强降雨／强风，则不会生成任何通知——**这是系统的正确行为，而不是 bug****。若想随时测试消息生成，可临时把 `.env` 中的阈值（`LIMIAR_CHUVA_MM`、`LIMIAR_VENTO_MS`）调到很低。」⭐⭐⭐ **对本会话而言，这一段的价值在于它**预先回答了最可能被误报为缺陷的现象****——**一个输出为空的演示通常会被当成失败**，**而作者把「空即正确」写在了前面，并给出**临时调低阈值**这条可复现的测试路径**（**可与第 331 轮 [[paco-uw]] 的「两种求值策略会分歧」、第 330 轮 [[catrisk-sim]] 的「synthetic and deliberately simplified」并读**——**三者都在**预先说明读者会看到什么、以及为什么那不是错误****）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **「无需为任何 API 付费」被写成了明确承诺**——**逐字为**：**「**Não é obrigatório pagar por nenhuma API.** Ambas as chaves acima têm camada gratuita **sem necessidade de cartão**.」**（**两个密钥都有免费额度且不需要信用卡**）；**其技术栈逐字为**：**Python 3.10+、Streamlit（界面）、requests（调用 OpenWeatherMap）、**LangChain + Google Gemini（免费）**，**并支持 Ollama（本地／免费）、Claude 与 GPT（付费）**、pandas（投保人数据）**。⭐⭐ **对资源有限的学生，这条承诺很有实际价值**——**它意味着一份作业可以在**零成本**下跑通**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其免费额度长期不变或足以支撑任何真实业务量**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **样例数据的规模与性质被逐字写清**——**「Observações」一节逐字为**：**「A base de segurados (`data/segurados.csv`) é **fictícia, criada para fins didáticos**, cobrindo **10 cidades brasileiras** (incluindo regiões costeiras) e **2 tipos de seguro** (Residencial e Automóvel), com **20 segurados no total**.」**、**「**Não há envio real de SMS/e-mail — apenas simulação**, conforme os requisitos do desafio.」**、**「**Chaves de API nunca devem ser commitadas — ficam apenas no `.env`** (no `.gitignore`).」**⭐⭐ **三点合起来构成一份**清楚的合成数据与密钥边界说明****（**20 名投保人、10 座城市、2 个险种**——**规模极小，**本词条据此**不主张**其可代表任何真实投保人群**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **团队成员表逐字实测，且是一支**跨职能学生团队****：**「Ednardo Pinheiro Peixoto — Representante e Engenheiro de IA/IoT/Tech Líder」**；**「**Glenda dos Santos Tavares — Atuária（精算师）**」**；**「Sueli Da Hora Moreira — Analytics Engineer」**；**「**Rafael Torres Lattaro Soares — Especialista em Seguros（保险专家）**」**。⭐⭐ **对做课程或竞赛项目的学生，这份名单本身就是一种**分工范本**：**精算、保险业务、数据工程与 AI 工程各有一人****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该分工在实践中一定有效**——**未获任何过程材料**）。**⑧ ⭐ **项目结构逐字实测**：`app.py`（**五个智能体的编排，Streamlit**）、`src/weather_agent.py`（**智能体 1 — 气象数据采集**）、`src/event_agent.py`（**智能体 2 — 事件识别**）、`src/rules_agent.py`（**智能体 3 — 业务规则**）、`src/message_agent.py`（**智能体 4 — 消息生成（LLM）**）、`src/notify_agent.py`（**智能体 5 — 发送模拟**）、`data/segurados.csv`、`requirements.txt`、`.env.example`、`README.md`**——⭐ **注意：README 自述「每个智能体是 `src/` 下的独立模块」**，**而其结构块把「哪个 agent 用 LLM」直接写在了文件名与注释里**（**`message_agent.py` 标注「(LLM)」**）。**⑨ ⭐ 可与本站保险科技与天气风险条目并读**：[[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]、[[insurance-support-agent]]、[[adk-insurance-recommendation-agent]]、[[open-meteo]]、[[gdacs]]、[[hurricaneguard]]、[[physrisk]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[georisk-finder]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics（10 项）、README（4,518 字节，葡萄牙语）全文的定位段、五智能体架构、技术栈、数据来源、安装与配置、执行五步、那条「这不是 bug」的实时数据说明、业务规则表、项目结构、Observações 三则、许可与团队成员表**，**并以 raw 探测确认 `src/rules_agent.py`、`data/segurados.csv` 与 `LICENSE` 均存在（HTTP 200）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装、未运行 `streamlit run app.py`、未配置任何 API 密钥、未调用 OpenWeatherMap 或任何大模型、未读 `app.py` 与 `src/` 下任何源码、未打开 `data/segurados.csv`、未查看其界面****，因此**不能转述其事件判定阈值、业务规则实现、提示词、消息文本或任何运行输出**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其五个智能体在实现中确实如 README 所述分工**——**尤其**「只有 `message_agent.py` 调用大模型」这一关键分工**，**本次只核实在 README 的架构与结构块中被如此描述**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**③ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其业务规则表（强降雨→住宅险、风暴→车险与住宅险、强风→住宅险）的完整性或依据**——**README 未说明该映射的来源**；**本词条**不主张**其符合任何保险公司的实际条款或承保范围**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「在理赔发生前触达可减少损失」这一立意的实际效果**——**其输出为消息生成与**模拟**发送**，**README **未提及任何减损度量****；**本词条**不主张**该原型产生任何减损效果**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其调用的 OpenWeatherMap 免费额度当前是否仍**无需信用卡**、以及 Gemini／Ollama 的接入是否如述**（**本次未配置任何密钥或调用任何服务**）；**⑥ ⭐ **未核实** `LIMIAR_CHUVA_MM` 与 `LIMIAR_VENTO_MS` 的默认值**；**⑦ ⭐ ⚠️ **其样例数据为**虚构**（**README 明写 `fictícia, criada para fins didáticos`**，**20 名投保人、10 座巴西城市、2 个险种**）**；**本词条**不主张**其可代表任何真实投保人群、地区风险分布或保险产品**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **该系统设计为向个人发送消息****——**在真实部署中涉及**联系方式与个人数据的处理、以及营销／通知的合规要求****；**README 提到**无真实短信或邮件发送**（**仅为模拟**）**并规定**密钥不得提交**；**本词条**不主张**其在数据保护或通信合规方面完备**（**本次未评估**）；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **其自述为**黑客松／课程挑战的作品（Desafio 5，隶属 I2A2／InsurMinds）****；**本词条**不主张**其可用于任何真实的保险公司预警、投保人触达或核保定价用途**；**⑩ ⭐ ★1、fork 0**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑪ ⭐ **README 为葡萄牙语**——**本词条已如实记入，**并注明**本次未核实是否有英文或中文版本**；**⑫ ⭐ topics 含 `seguros`（保险）与 `i2a2`**（**后者指向该挑战的主办方**），**其分类与内容一致**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/EDNARDOPPEIXOTO99/insurminds-desafio5-comunicacao-proativa` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可、★数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 10 项 topics）；README 4,518 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**`src/rules_agent.py`、`data/segurados.csv` 与 `LICENSE` 经 raw 探测确认存在（HTTP 200）**；**未克隆、未安装、未运行、未配置密钥、未读源码**。

**insurminds-desafio5** 是一個**葡萄牙語的氣象預警觸達原型**（倉庫 `EDNARDOPPEIXOTO99/insurminds-desafio5-comunicacao-proativa`），**實測 MIT 許可（`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 200）、★1、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 337 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-07**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**實測 topics 10 項**：**`agentes-inteligentes`、`google-gemini`、`i2a2`、`ia-generativa`、`insurtech`、`langchain`、`openweathermap`、`python`、**`seguros`**、`streamlit`**；**README 實測 4,518 位元組（葡萄牙語）**。**已實測存在的關鍵檔案**：**`src/rules_agent.py`、`data/segurados.csv`、`LICENSE`**。本條目屬本輪主題**「分開『我看到了什麼』與『我因此斷定什麼』」**中的**第二種，也是本站首次收錄**葡萄牙語**專案**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：**標題逐字「InsurMinds — Desafio 5 / **Ferramenta Inteligente para Comunicação Proativa com o Segurado**」**（「與投保人主動溝通的智能工具」），**團隊逐字「**Grupo InsurTech Minds**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **定位逐字**：**「Protótipo (MVP) que monitoriza condições meteorológicas em tempo real e gera comunicações automáticas e personalizadas para segurados, **antes que um sinistro ocorra** — **transformando o modelo reativo das seguradoras em uma abordagem preventiva**.」**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「五個智能體裡只有生成訊息那個用大模型」是最重要的一點，也是本輪主題最清晰的分工樣本**——**架構逐字**：①`ColetorClimaticoAgent`（**按城市查詢 OpenWeatherMap**）；②`AnalisadorEventosAgent`（**識別降雨／風／風暴**）；③`RegrasNegocioAgent`（**決定哪些投保人應被通知**）；④`GeradorMensagemAgent`（**透過大模型 Gemini 生成個人化訊息**）；⑤`SimuladorEnvioAgent`（**記錄模擬發送，無真實集成**）⭐⭐⭐ **即：**感知與判定全部由確定性智能體完成，大模型只負責**把已定好的決定寫成一句人話****——**與本站連續多輪同一判斷一致**（**329 按列型／329 正則優先／330 按架構／331 偏好序＋禁止清單／332 規則即資料／332 理算人路由／本輪 [[claimlens]] 成本與法律引用**）；**本條的特點是**粒度最細**：**同一個多智能體流程裡恰好一個是生成式的****。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「把保險公司的被動模式轉成主動模式」是業務立意上最值得記的一點**——**在理賠發生之前觸達投保人**（**如預報強降雨時提前通知住宅險投保人**）⭐⭐ **這是一條把保險從「事後賠付」向「事前減損」推移的具體路徑**，**而減損直接影響賠付頻率**（**⚠️ **insurminds-desafio5** is **a Portuguese-language weather-warning outreach prototype** (repository `EDNARDOPPEIXOTO99/insurminds-desafio5-comunicacao-proativa`), with **measured MIT licence (`LICENSE` measured 200 on main), ★1, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 337 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **ten topics measurably present**: **`agentes-inteligentes`, `google-gemini`, `i2a2`, `ia-generativa`, `insurtech`, `langchain`, `openweathermap`, `python`, `seguros` and `streamlit`**; **the README measures 4,518 bytes and is in Portuguese**. **Key files measurably present**: **`src/rules_agent.py`, `data/segurados.csv` and `LICENSE`**. It is the second of this round’s four takes on **separating "what I observed" from "what I therefore conclude"**, **and it is the first Portuguese-language project collected here** (**earlier entries repeatedly closed with "whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified"; this one is in Portuguese, recorded as such**).

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): **the title reads verbatim "InsurMinds — Desafio 5 / Ferramenta Inteligente para Comunicação Proativa com o Segurado"** ("an intelligent tool for proactive communication with the insured"), **credited to "Grupo InsurTech Minds"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Its positioning, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important passage**: **"Protótipo (MVP) que monitoriza condições meteorológicas em tempo real e gera comunicações automáticas e personalizadas para segurados, antes que um sinistro ocorra — transformando o modelo reativo das seguradoras em uma abordagem preventiva."** — **an MVP that monitors weather in real time and generates automatic personalised communications to policyholders before a claim occurs, turning insurers’ reactive model into a preventive one**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ That only the message-writing agent of five uses an LLM is the entry’s most important point and this round’s clearest division-of-labour sample** — **its multi-agent architecture reads verbatim as**: **① `ColetorClimaticoAgent`** (queries the OpenWeatherMap API per city); **② `AnalisadorEventosAgent`** (identifies relevant events: rain, wind, storm); **③ `RegrasNegocioAgent`** (decides which policyholders should be notified); **④ `GeradorMensagemAgent`** (generates the personalised message via the Gemini LLM); **⑤ `SimuladorEnvioAgent`** (records a simulated send with no real integration). ⭐⭐⭐ **Perception and decision are entirely deterministic agents; the LLM only renders an already-made decision into a sentence a person can read** — **consistent with the judgement that recurs across this site** (**column kinds in round 329’s [[insurance-tabular-review]], regex-first in that round’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]], architecture in round 330’s [[actuary-os]], a preference ordering plus prohibition list in round 331’s [[claim-ops]], rules as pure data in round 332’s [[paco-uw]], adjuster routing left to a rule engine in that round’s [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]], and costing and legal citations left to pure deterministic rules in this round’s [[claimlens]]**); **what is distinctive here is the finest granularity: within one multi-agent pipeline, exactly one agent is generative**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ Turning insurers’ reactive model into a preventive one is the entry’s most notable business idea** — **it reaches policyholders before a claim occurs** (**for instance notifying residential policyholders ahead of forecast heavy rain**); ⭐⭐ **for students of insurance innovation this is a concrete path from post-loss indemnity toward pre-loss mitigation — and mitigation directly affects claim frequency** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the prototype quantifies any mitigation effect — its output is message generation and a simulated send, and the README mentions no mitigation measurement**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its business-rules table reads verbatim and is an explicit event-to-line mapping**: **"Chuva intensa" (heavy rain) → residential**; **"Tempestade (risco de granizo)" (storm with hail risk) → motor and residential**; **"Vento forte" (strong wind) → residential**. ⭐⭐ **For students of catastrophe or weather risk, that table links weather event types directly to affected lines — a simplified but correct hazard-to-exposure mapping** (**readable with [[catrisk-sim]], [[west-bengal-flood-cat-model]], [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]], [[open-meteo]], [[gdacs]] and [[hurricaneguard]]**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim the mapping is complete or matches any insurer’s actual terms — strong wind plainly affects motor too, yet the table lists only residential**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ A pre-emptive "this is not a bug" note is the entry’s most notable documentation quality** — verbatim: **"Como os dados climáticos são consultados em tempo real, os eventos disparados dependem do clima do dia em que você rodar a aplicação. Se nenhuma das 10 cidades da base estiver com chuva/vento forte no momento, nenhuma notificação será gerada — isso é o comportamento correto do sistema, não um bug. Para testar a geração de mensagens a qualquer momento, ajuste temporariamente os limiares no `.env` (`LIMIAR_CHUVA_MM`, `LIMIAR_VENTO_MS`) para valores bem baixos."** ⭐⭐⭐ **A demo that produces no output is normally read as failure, whereas the author states up front that empty is correct and gives a reproducible test path by temporarily lowering the thresholds** (**readable with round 331’s [[paco-uw]] and round 330’s [[catrisk-sim]] — all three pre-announce what a reader will see and why it is not an error**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ "No API payment is required" is stated as a firm promise** — verbatim: **"Não é obrigatório pagar por nenhuma API. Ambas as chaves acima têm camada gratuita sem necessidade de cartão."**; **its stack reads verbatim as Python 3.10+, Streamlit, requests, LangChain with Google Gemini (free) — also supporting Ollama (local/free), Claude and GPT (paid) — and pandas** ⭐⭐ **for a student on a budget this matters: it means coursework can run end to end at zero cost** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the free tiers are permanent or sufficient for any real volume**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ The sample data’s scale and nature are stated verbatim**: **"A base de segurados (`data/segurados.csv`) é fictícia, criada para fins didáticos, cobrindo 10 cidades brasileiras (incluindo regiões costeiras) e 2 tipos de seguro (Residencial e Automóvel), com 20 segurados no total."**, **"Não há envio real de SMS/e-mail — apenas simulação"**, **and "Chaves de API nunca devem ser commitadas — ficam apenas no `.env`"** (**20 policyholders, 10 cities, 2 lines — very small, so the entry does not claim it represents any real policyholder population**). **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ Its team table reads verbatim and is a cross-functional student team**: **Ednardo Pinheiro Peixoto (representative and AI/IoT/tech lead)**, **Glenda dos Santos Tavares (Atuária — actuary)**, **Sueli Da Hora Moreira (Analytics Engineer)** and **Rafael Torres Lattaro Soares (Especialista em Seguros — insurance specialist)**. ⭐⭐ **For students doing coursework or competitions the roster is itself a division-of-labour template: one each for actuarial, insurance practice, data engineering and AI engineering** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the split works in practice — no process material was seen**). **⑧ ⭐ Its project structure reads verbatim**: `app.py` (**orchestrating the five agents, Streamlit**), `src/weather_agent.py`, `src/event_agent.py`, `src/rules_agent.py`, `src/message_agent.py` (**annotated "(LLM)"**), `src/notify_agent.py`, `data/segurados.csv`, `requirements.txt`, `.env.example` and `README.md` — ⭐ **note that the structure block writes which agent uses an LLM directly into the filename and comment**. **⑨ ⭐ Readable with the site’s insurtech and weather-risk entries**: [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]], [[insurance-support-agent]], [[adk-insurance-recommendation-agent]], [[open-meteo]], [[gdacs]], [[hurricaneguard]], [[physrisk]], [[typhoon-cat-model]] and [[georisk-finder]].
